## Christmas shortlist — **cosy-but-polished, with a party-food welcome**

### Gluten-free starters from Sainsbury’s
1. **Salmon parcels with Melba toast** — *elegant*  
   Smoked salmon, soft cheese, lemon, chives and avocado, served as individual parcels; Sainsbury’s specifically calls it a Christmas starter. **Important:** use gluten-free bread/toasts rather than the recipe’s standard white-bread star toasts. **£1.38 per serving** (recipe estimate; serves 8). **Best overall pick**: it looks properly celebratory and leads naturally into glazed ham.
2. **Free From 10 Tempura Prawns, 130g** — *party-food but smart*  
   **£3.00**. A crisp seafood option that can be served with a festive citrus/chilli dip; listed as gluten-free and frozen.
3. **Free From 12 Indian Inspired Snack Selection, 240g** — *cosy, sharing-style*  
   **£3.50**. Four vegetable samosas, four onion bhajis and four vegetable pakoras — all stated gluten-free. Best if the get-together is more informal buffet than sit-down dinner.

### Main-course picture: glazed spiral ham
The strongest full-menu pairing is the **salmon parcels followed by a glossy, festive ham**. The Kitchn’s spiral-ham guidance is to avoid drying the pre-cooked slices: keep the ham **tightly foil-wrapped while gently reheating**, then **uncover for the final roughly 30 minutes**, basting and working the glaze between the slices. Their search result cites heating to **140°F / 60°C**; use the package instructions as the primary guide. A brown-sugar/citrus or ginger-forward glaze would echo the salmon’s lemon and make the menu feel traditional without becoming heavy. (The Kitchn page itself blocked automated access, so I relied on its indexed guidance.)

### M&S dad stocking fillers — all £20 or under
1. **Cardsafe™ Cardholder — £12**  
   **Most useful / best M&S pick.** Faux leather, several card slots plus a notes compartment, and contactless-card scan protection; understated rather than novelty.
2. **Borg Slipper Socks — £12**  
   **Best cosy option.** Soft borg finish with non-slip grips — a genuinely Christmassy, practical small gift.
3. **Solutions for Men Energise and Refresh Body Spray Set — £8**  
   **Best value grooming filler.** Two portable sprays designed for body or clothing; an easy, non-jokey present.

### Boots polished-backup gift sets
1. **Old Spice Captain Travel Bag Gift Set (deodorant stick, spray and shower gel) — £15**  
   **Best gift-page pick.** Adds a reusable wash bag, so it feels much more complete than a loose stocking filler. Captain scent: ocean waves, sandalwood and bergamot. It is also in Boots’ 3-for-2 selected Christmas mix-and-match offer.
2. **Hunter Wash & Mini EDT Set — £18**  
   A compact **wash plus mini eau de toilette** set, so it is the more fragrance-led, polished alternative; also in the selected 3-for-2 offer.

### Tabs left open for visual comparison
- **Sainsbury’s:** Salmon parcels with Melba toast (most promising starter)
- **M&S:** Cardsafe™ Cardholder (best practical dad gift)
- **Boots:** Old Spice Captain Travel Bag Gift Set (best polished gift-set backup)

Prices and availability are those shown on the retailer pages when checked.

args.summary:
## Christmas shortlist — **cosy-but-polished, with a party-food welcome**

### Gluten-free starters from Sainsbury’s
1. **Salmon parcels with Melba toast** — *elegant*  
   Smoked salmon, soft cheese, lemon, chives and avocado, served as individual parcels; Sainsbury’s specifically calls it a Christmas starter. **Important:** use gluten-free bread/toasts rather than the recipe’s standard white-bread star toasts. **£1.38 per serving** (recipe estimate; serves 8). **Best overall pick**: it looks properly celebratory and leads naturally into glazed ham.
2. **Free From 10 Tempura Prawns, 130g** — *party-food but smart*  
   **£3.00**. A crisp seafood option that can be served with a festive citrus/chilli dip; listed as gluten-free and frozen.
3. **Free From 12 Indian Inspired Snack Selection, 240g** — *cosy, sharing-style*  
   **£3.50**. Four vegetable samosas, four onion bhajis and four vegetable pakoras — all stated gluten-free. Best if the get-together is more informal buffet than sit-down dinner.

### Main-course picture: glazed spiral ham
The strongest full-menu pairing is the **salmon parcels followed by a glossy, festive ham**. The Kitchn’s spiral-ham guidance is to avoid drying the pre-cooked slices: keep the ham **tightly foil-wrapped while gently reheating**, then **uncover for the final roughly 30 minutes**, basting and working the glaze between the slices. Their search result cites heating to **140°F / 60°C**; use the package instructions as the primary guide. A brown-sugar/citrus or ginger-forward glaze would echo the salmon’s lemon and make the menu feel traditional without becoming heavy. (The Kitchn page itself blocked automated access, so I relied on its indexed guidance.)

### M&S dad stocking fillers — all £20 or under
1. **Cardsafe™ Cardholder — £12**  
   **Most useful / best M&S pick.** Faux leather, several card slots plus a notes compartment, and contactless-card scan protection; understated rather than novelty.
2. **Borg Slipper Socks — £12**  
   **Best cosy option.** Soft borg finish with non-slip grips — a genuinely Christmassy, practical small gift.
3. **Solutions for Men Energise and Refresh Body Spray Set — £8**  
   **Best value grooming filler.** Two portable sprays designed for body or clothing; an easy, non-jokey present.

### Boots polished-backup gift sets
1. **Old Spice Captain Travel Bag Gift Set (deodorant stick, spray and shower gel) — £15**  
   **Best gift-page pick.** Adds a reusable wash bag, so it feels much more complete than a loose stocking filler. Captain scent: ocean waves, sandalwood and bergamot. It is also in Boots’ 3-for-2 selected Christmas mix-and-match offer.
2. **Hunter Wash & Mini EDT Set — £18**  
   A compact **wash plus mini eau de toilette** set, so it is the more fragrance-led, polished alternative; also in the selected 3-for-2 offer.

### Tabs left open for visual comparison
- **Sainsbury’s:** Salmon parcels with Melba toast (most promising starter)
- **M&S:** Cardsafe™ Cardholder (best practical dad gift)
- **Boots:** Old Spice Captain Travel Bag Gift Set (best polished gift-set backup)

Prices and availability are those shown on the retailer pages when checked.
